description: Non-null, bounded native controls supplementing the full registry marker and typed-NULL audits.

cases.sql: SELECT position('abc', 'b') AS v
SELECT position('b' IN 'abc') AS v
SELECT substring('abcdef', 2, 3) AS v
SELECT substring('abcdef' FROM 2 FOR 3) AS v
SELECT trim(BOTH 'x' FROM 'xxabxx') AS v
SELECT overlay('abcdef' PLACING 'XY' FROM 2 FOR 3) AS v
SELECT isnan(CAST('NaN' AS DOUBLE)) AS v
SELECT to_hex(255) AS v
SELECT signum(0.0) AS v
SELECT var_pop(v) AS p, var_samp(v) AS s FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (4)) t(v)
SELECT sum(v) FILTER (WHERE v > 1) AS v FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (3)) t(v)
SELECT first_value(v ORDER BY v DESC) AS v FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) t(v)
SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT v ORDER BY v DESC) AS v FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (1)) t(v)
SELECT count(DISTINCT a,b) AS v FROM (VALUES (1,2),(1,3),(NULL,2)) t(a,b)
SELECT id, first_value(v) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS v FROM (VALUES (1,NULL), (2,9)) t(id,v) ORDER BY id
SELECT [10,20,30][1] AS v
SELECT struct(1 AS a, 'b' AS b) AS v
SELECT date_format(DATE '2024-01-02', '%d/%m/%Y') AS v
SELECT CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(18,3)) AS v
WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS id), b AS (SELECT 1 AS id, 2 AS v) SELECT a.id, b.v FROM a LEFT JOIN b USING (id) ORDER BY a.id
SELECT v FROM (SELECT 2 AS v UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS v) t ORDER BY v LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
SELECT a, sum(b) AS s FROM (VALUES (1,2),(1,3)) t(a,b) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((a), ()) ORDER BY a NULLS LAST
SELECT * REPLACE (a+1 AS a) FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b) t
SELECT * EXCEPT (b) FROM (SELECT 1 AS a, 2 AS b) t
SELECT x, (SELECT count(*) FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) b(y) WHERE y = x) AS n FROM (VALUES (1),(3)) a(x) ORDER BY x
SELECT E'\x41' AS v
SELECT E'\u0041' AS v
SELECT E'\101' AS v
SELECT E'\q' AS v
SELECT E'\uD800' AS v
SELECT array_agg(v, ORDER BY v) FROM t
SELECT concat(a,,b)
SELECT "SUM"(1) AS v
SELECT "sum"(v) AS v FROM (VALUES (1),(2)) t(v)
